displayTitle: The Force Awakens: The 10th Anniversary Special Edition
synopsis: A deluxe, fully illustrated look at the making of the first chapter of the sequel trilogy, the 2015 blockbuster, Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens. This hardcover volume features a behind-the-scenes look at the making of Star Wars: The Force Awakens, from script development to concept art and costume designs, through to filming and eventual release. Lavishly illustrated with photography and imagery from the Lucasfilm Archives, this must-have collector's edition also includes interviews with stars Harrison Ford, Daisy Ridley, and John Boyega.
title: The Force Awakens: The 10th Anniversary Special Edition
